opennyai_summary.facts:
A case has been registered against the petitioner herein and others for the offences under Sections. 420, 406, 409, 120-B Indian Penal Code and Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act,1998.
3.
The case of the prosecution is that M/S.Srinivasa Aqua Farms, a Partnership Firm, represented by its Managing Partner-Accused No.1 and other partners, were engaged in Fish Rearing Activity; that the unit was established in August 2020 and having its registered office located at Palakol, West Godavari District; that the Firm approached the defacto complainant-State Bank of India,
Tadikallapudi Branch for sanction of Agricultural Asset Backed Loan for an amount of Rs.2.92 Crores for Fish Rearing Activity; that the request of the Firm was duly accepted, considered and sanctioned the loan vide letter dated 28.08.2020; that the petitioner and others had executed the loan document and created mortgage of the properties in favour of the defacto complainant-SBI;
that subsequently it was observed that though M/s Srinivasa Aqua Farms have no agricultural lands in its name, but took some lands on lease and availed Agricultural Asset Backed Loan and thereafter proceeds of the loan were diverted into different individual accounts and thereby committed criminal misappropriation, cheating, criminal breach of trust in order to defraud KSR,J the Bank;
that the petitioner being Manager of State Bank of India, SBI, Tadikalapudi Branch has colluded with the partners of the M/S.Srinivasa Aqua Farms and diverted the loan amount into the individual accounts.
4. This court, having perused the entire material on record and taking into note of the specific allegations made against the petitioner in the First Information Report, is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner at this stage.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Hence, the Criminal petition is liable to be dismissed.
5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is dismissed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
